lots.title: Provision of Water Risk Assessments
lots.description: Lot 2 of framework reference 6278 (London Borough of Bexley, Building Services Framework, Lots 1-11). This document is the PSQ Reference Appendices for Lot 2 only: Appendix 1 reference form and Appendix 2 referee cover letter. No technical specification, scope of works, or product schedule is contained in this document.
requirements: Applicant must supply one completed reference form (Part A) per reference, covering named contact, brief description of services provided, dates and annual value.
Part B (referee section) must be completed by the referee and returned directly to procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026 by 5pm; it must not be returned via the applicant.

The six criteria rendered under evaluation_criteria are referee-assessment dimensions for a past-performance reference (supply chain resilience, service provision, resource, value for money, contract management, project management). They are not tender award criteria; they are supplier-qualification reference dimensions. Downstream consumers should not weight these as price/quality award criteria for Lot 2.
